voiceover: Some of the most formidable witnesses for the faith set out to disprove it. This section tells nine of their stories. The investigators — a legal journalist, a cold-case detective, and one of the world's most successful trial lawyers. The thinkers — C. S. Lewis, Augustine, and Pascal. And the transformed — a slave trader who wrote Amazing Grace, a devout Muslim, and a tenured professor. None of them is a proof on its own — but together, this many and this unwilling, they are a pattern worth reckoning with. Every argument across the Evidence Library gets a fully-cited deep-dive essay. Each claim is sourced, and the strongest objections are stated fairly, then answered. That is our standard — Checked Before Published. And you will not just read. On every essay an AI tutor answers your questions — ask it anything, or highlight a single sentence and ask about that exact line. Mastery mode lets you explain the argument back in your own words and have it graded. Daily practice brings the key points back just as you are about to forget them. There are pocket cards to share, and a Debate Arena to practise against an AI sceptic before the real conversation. Every essay comes in a plain-English version and a full deep dive, with read-aloud audio. These are not proofs; they are evidence with a face — an invitation to look at what they saw. Start anywhere, and follow it where it leads.
